::: {#exm-rss-vector}
#### Residual sum of squares in vector notation

In simple linear regression, take $\vth = \vcoef$
and substitute $\mean(x_i) = \dprod{\vxi}{\vcoef}$ (@lem-slr-mean-dot-product)
into each residual of the residual sum of squares (@def-rss).
The residual sum of squares is then a function of the coefficient vector $\vcoef$,
the same function as $\text{RSS}(\intcoef, \coef{x})$ in @exm-rss-slr:

$$
\text{RSS}(\vcoef) = \sumin \paren{y_i - \dprod{\vxi}{\vcoef}}^2.
$$
:::
